'''Dram Parkins''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Parkins traveled aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and frequented its [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] table.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dram Parkins only appeared as an example character in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition rulebook]] of [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' designed by [[Greg Costikyan]], published in [[October]] [[1987]].
